description: Finds EchoCall tools that are not in this list, for example for billing and balance, chatbots, knowledge bases, integrations, webhooks, team, presence, tickets or, for partner accounts, customers. Answers with the best matching tools, each with its description and full input schema, and the names of further matches. Run a tool you found with run_tool. Reading the catalogue costs nothing and changes nothing.

limit.description: How many matching tools to return with their input schema, 1 to 10. Further matches come back by name only.

query.description: What the tool should do, in a few English words (for example "top up balance", "knowledge base", "invoice pdf"), a tool name, or an area.

name: search_tools
title: Search EchoCall tools
